LAW AND MOTION 301, PLAINTIFF WILLIAM SEELEY'S MOTION TO STAY ARBITRATION. NO APPEARANCES ON THIS MATTER. THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING: DENIED. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO PREPARE AN ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR #8189

LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANT GEORGE SZYMKIEWICZ AND THERESA KUNZ'S MOTION TO COMPEL ARBITRATION. NO APPEARANCES ON THIS MATTER. THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING: GRANTED. ARBITRATION COMPELLED AND THIS ACTION IS STAYED. PLAINTIFF HAS FAILED TO PROVE THAT DEFENDANT WAIVED HIS RIGHT TO ARBITRATE BY HAVING BRIEFLY FILED AN ACTION TO WHICH NO ANSWER WAS FILED AND IN WHICH NO FORMAL DISCOVERY WAS TAKEN. THE ONLY SIGNIFICANT EXPENSES ARE ATTRIBUTED TO SETTLEMENT AND MEDIATION EFFORTS, RATHER THAN THE LITIGATION, AND THE ONLY DISCOVERY RESPONSES PROCURED WERE TO AN INFORMAL REQUEST TO WHICH THE DEFENDANT WOULD HAVE BEEN ENTITLED IN ARBITRATION, IN ANY EVENT. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO PREPARE AN ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR #8189
